persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Make a 6-second video of a tiny robot watering a sunflower. Everything else is your call—surprise me.
bank.Subject and action: A tiny robot watering a sunflower.

messages.text: I'd like you to make a video for me, and I'm leaving most of the creative decisions up to you. I just like the thought of a little moment of kindness, which is why this idea appealed to me. What I have in mind is a tiny robot watering a sunflower, and the video should be 6 seconds long. I sometimes overthink creative choices, so I'm happy not to be the one deciding them this time. Everything else is your call—surprise me.
